changelog:
- Improved the skill description for clarity and focus on supported document types and translation use-cases.
- Clarified workflow: always confirm with user before downloading the translated file; explicitly report WAIT_TIMEOUT and save request_id for resuming translation.
- Added instructions to stop and report immediately for exit 2 (auth/config) errors and WAIT_TIMEOUT.
- Updated descriptions to emphasize trigger scenarios (file upload or user request to translate/convert documents).
- No changes to code or JSON contracts; documentation and usage guidance improved.
